package.description: A useful and convenient formula recognition software~ Snip & Get!

en-US.description: A useful and convenient formula recognition software~ Snip & Get!
en-US.longDescription: Simply snipping a formula image or uploading from local, you will immediately get the Markdown or LaTeX expression of the mathematical formula! SimpleTex supports fast insertion of image/MathML/LaTeX and other formats to major document editing software, which could greatly boost work efficiency.
en-US.name: SimpleTex

zh-CN.description: 一款方便且好用的公式/文档识别编辑软件平台~
zh-CN.longDescription: 只需轻松截取公式图片或上传本地图像/文档文件，即可快速获得目标的 Markdown 或 LaTeX 表达，支持快速插入图片/MathML/LaTeX/Docx 等格式至各大办公与排版软件，极大地提高了工作效率。
zh-CN.name: SimpleTex
